body:
I have taken 2c-t-2 numerous times and have found that insufflation is the best method for me. Even though the burn is intense it is worth it. I have found that doing small 'bumps' continously until desired effects are met. By doing this I believe I have done more than 70mg. and have had amazing experiences. I have a hard time getting my friends to try high doses by this route as nausea, vomiting, and diarhea are expected within 10 minutes ever time I insufflate. So I feel I am the only one who has experienced this great phenethylamine at these high doses.
Oral route has not been very successful as it takes more to get off, and draws out the time of sickness. I am very curious about the I.V route but have not tried it, I would like to read more experiences with dosages. I have found this phenethylamine to be very physically pleasurable, and very visual. As far as mentally it produces a very positive happy attitude without much affect on clarity of thought. I would love to use 2c-t-2 everyday if it wasnt so hard to ingest.
